## Imports

```{python}
import numpy as np
```


```{python}
def cal_score(score_matrix, seq1, seq2, i, j, match, mismatch, gap):
    if seq1[i - 1] == seq2[j - 1]:
        diag_score = score_matrix[i - 1, j - 1] + match
    else:
        diag_score = score_matrix[i - 1, j - 1] + mismatch
    up_score = score_matrix[i - 1, j] + gap
    left_score = score_matrix[i, j - 1] + gap
    
    score = max(0, diag_score, up_score, left_score)
    
    if score == 0:
        direction = 0
    elif score == diag_score:
        direction = 1
    elif score == up_score:
        direction = 2
    else:
        direction = 3
    
    return score, direction

```


```{python}
def traceback(seq1, seq2, traceback_matrix, maximum_position):
    aligned_seq1 = ''
    aligned_seq2 = ''
    i, j = maximum_position
    move = traceback_matrix[i][j]
    while move != 0:
        if move == 1:
            aligned_seq1 += seq1[i - 1]
            aligned_seq2 += seq2[j - 1]
            i -= 1
            j -= 1
        elif move == 2:
            aligned_seq1 += seq1[i - 1]
            aligned_seq2 += '-'
            i -= 1
        elif move == 3:
            aligned_seq1 += '-'
            aligned_seq2 += seq2[j - 1]
            j -= 1
        move = traceback_matrix[i][j]
        
    return aligned_seq1[::-1], aligned_seq2[::-1]
```

```{python}
def smith_waterman(seq1, seq2, match=1, mismatch=-1, gap=-1):
    column = len(seq1) + 1
    row = len(seq2) + 1
    score_matrix = np.zeros((column, row))
    score_matrix = score_matrix.astype(int)
    traceback_matrix = np.zeros((column, row))
    traceback_matrix = traceback_matrix.astype(int)
    max_score = 0
    
    for i in range(1, column):
        for j in range(1, row):
            score, direction = cal_score(score_matrix, seq1, seq2, i, j, match, mismatch, gap)
            score_matrix[i][j] = score
            traceback_matrix[i][j] = direction
            if score >= max_score:
                max_score = score
                maximum_position = (i, j)
    
    aligned_seq1, aligned_seq2 = traceback(seq1, seq2, traceback_matrix, maximum_position)

    
    return aligned_seq1, aligned_seq2, score_matrix
```
